## `neuro.bigInt64Array.fill`

Instance method on `BigInt64Array.prototype`.

> Changes all array elements from `start` to `end` index to a static `value` and returns the modified array

## Signatures

```ts
fill(input: { bigInt64Array: <receiver>; value: bigint; start?: number; end?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<BigInt64Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigInt64Array.prototype.fill` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
